Thr. ... on 14 August, 2024

Author: M. W. Chandwani
Bench: Avinash G. Gharote, M. W. Chandwani
 2024:Bhc-Nag:9018-Db
 1 
 In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay,
 Nagpur Bench, Nagpur.
 Writ Petition No. 7872 Of 2023
 Supchand S/o. Godan Hirapure
 Vs.
 The State of Maharashtra and other
 ---------------------------------------------------------

entities.text:
High Court Of Judicature At Bombay,
 Nagpur Bench, Nagpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Office Notes, Office Memoranda of 
 Coram, appearances, Court's Orders
 or directions and Registrar's order
 ---------------------------------------------------------
 Shri R. M. Pande, Advocate for petitioner.
 Shri A. S. Fulzele, Advocate for respondent
 Coram :- Avinash G. Gharote &
 M. W. Chandwani, Jj.
Dated :- 14.08.2024

There is no dispute regarding passing of the award dated 03.02.2023 under Section 28A of Land Acquisition Act, 1894 by the Land Acquisition Officer, Gondia, in which compensation of Rs.61,62,936/- has been awarded to the petitioner.
The only grievance is that the payment has not been done on the ground that grants have not been received.
2. The learned AGP for the State, on instructions, makes a statement that the payment shall be made within a period of three months from today.
3. Accepting which, the petition is disposed of in terms of the aforesaid statement.
(M. W. CHANDWANI, J.) (AVINASH G. GHAROTE, J.) Signed by: Mr. Rajnesh Jaiswal Designation: PARR ToJaiswal Honourable Judge
